chunks: Abdul-Wahid ibn Muhammad ibn Abdous al-Attar told us, saying: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutayba told us, from Hamdan ibn Sulayman, from Ahmad ibn Fadlan, who said: Sulayman ibn Ja'far al-Marwazi told us, from Thabit ibn Abi Safiya, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: An Arab said to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah. He said: I am not the Prophet of Allah, but I am the Prophet of Allah.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Nabi Allah and Nabiyyu Allah in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) corrects an Arab man’s address, distinguishing between 'Nabi' Allah' (a Prophet belonging to Allah) and 'Nabiyyu Allah' (The Prophet of Allah), emphasizing the precision of titles in addressing the Prophet. This distinction highlights the unique status of the Prophet as the final messenger, a concept reinforced by Quranic verses such as 33:40, which declare him the 'Seal of the Prophets.' The correction underscores the importance of accurate terminology in recognizing the Prophet’s divine appointment and authority.
